name: reverse-engineering-saas
description: Skill for studying a SaaS web product through the browser and building a rebuild-grade knowledge base without touching production data.

plugins.name: reverse-engineering-saas
plugins.description: Reverse engineer a SaaS product (ClickUp, Pipedrive, any web app) into a knowledge base: screens, components, rules, data model, API shapes and design tokens, with a sandbox protocol, a change ledger and an automated check.
